name: Key Apprenticeship Program apprentice incentive
provider: Department of Employment and Workplace Relations
summary: Commonwealth payments to apprentices in clean energy or housing construction occupations, paid at milestones through to completion.
key: $2,000 per payment for full-time and $1,000 for part-time apprentices, at 6, 12, 24 and 36 months and on completion.
who: Certificate III or higher apprenticeship linked to a clean energy or housing construction priority outcome
Employer works in that sector and both sign a commitment declaration
catches: Amounts are from the payments table; check the program guidelines before relying on them.
Cannot be paid together with the Australian Apprentice Training Support Payment for the same apprenticeship.

source.label: DEWR: Australian Apprenticeships Incentive System payments overview

evidence.quote: Payments at 6, 12, 24, 36 months and on completion
